item.title: Prerequisites
item.description:
The following tools are required to use Presidium:

  1. Install Homebrew

    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

  2. Install Presidium

    brew install SPANDigital/tap/presidium
